text: Given the high importance of ensuring data integrity and availability, choosing an audited system with certified failover as the records vendor is unequivocally the optimal choice. This option guarantees that the clinic's critical information remains secure even during unexpected failures, providing peace of mind for all patients and staff alike. The certification process ensures that the chosen solution meets stringent quality standards set forth by reputable organizations, further enhancing the reliability and trustworthiness of the selected provider.
